title: Pricing Memorandum: Payment at Issue on a Late-Filed TRICARE Select Line (Appeals and Grievances)
content:
**Appeals pricing memorandum — Appeals and Grievances**

**Subject:** the amount in dispute on a Claim Factual Reconsideration opened on a TRICARE Select claim line denied because the claim reached the region after the filing deadline.

1. *What the amount is.* The amount in dispute on such a case is the TRICARE payment the line would have carried had it been paid — the payment at issue on the line. The beneficiary owes the provider nothing on a line denied for the provider's late filing, so no beneficiary liability is at issue on it.
2. *Records read.* The line's own TRICARE Select record: its service date, claim number, provider, service class, billed amount and the provider's network status on it; and the TRICARE Select enrollment the line was billed under, whose tier supplies the cost-share figures in the TRICARE Select schedule.
3. *Allowed amount at issue.* The amount the provider billed on the line, divided for a nonparticipating provider by one plus the tier's nonparticipating balance-billing limit (a limit of p percent divides by one plus p hundredths), rounded to the cent.
4. *Cost share.* The network outpatient cost-share percentage of the tier the line was billed under, applied to the allowed amount at issue and rounded to the cent. Under a tier that charges fixed network copayments, the cost share on a network line other than preventive care is that tier's network copayment for the line's service class, never more than the amount the cost share is figured on, rounded to the cent.
5. *Payment at issue.* The allowed amount at issue less the cost share, rounded to the cent. That payment at issue is the amount in dispute recorded on the case.

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs; the actual percentages, copayments and limit are the figures of the TRICARE Select tier)**

| | Line A | Line B | Line C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Provider on the line | network | network | network |
| Tier's cost-share form | percentage (20 percent network outpatient) | fixed copayments (41.00 for a specialty care visit) | fixed copayments (41.00 for a specialty care visit) |
| Service class | primary care visit | specialty care visit | specialty care visit |
| Billed amount | 250.00 | 250.00 | 30.00 |
| Allowed amount at issue | 250.00 | 250.00 | 30.00 |
| Cost share | 20 percent of 250.00, 50.00 | 41.00 | 41.00 capped at 30.00 |
| Payment at issue, the amount in dispute | 200.00 | 209.00 | 0.00 |

For a nonparticipating provider billing 460.00 under a tier with a hypothetical 15 percent balance-billing limit, the allowed amount at issue is 460.00 divided by 1.15, which is 400.00; the cost share and the payment at issue then follow items 4 and 5 on that 400.00.
